title: Integrate and validate the native design release candidate
outcome: Integrate the approved native visual port, guarantee state-aware Watch entry, and validate the combined candidate with source, build and simulator checks.

included: Integrate the three bounded design results and record independent review.
Handle shared project generation and localization reconciliation, and correct integration findings.
Reset active Watch presentation to elapsed when entered from a complication without mutating the timer.
Run the full clean-source CI gate and preserve exact-candidate evidence.
excluded: Persistence schema and cross-device protocol changes.
Version allocation and signed archive, handled by the release steward.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The combined native visual port passes independent source review and project/localization reconciliation.
Full CI passes on a clean candidate including state-aware idle and paused URL entry, timer accounting and privacy regression coverage.
